name: Decompos_It
shortDescription: Android app that labels a photographed item with ML Kit and shows how long it takes to decompose, with notes on what affects it.
description:
An Android app built for an ICS4U environmental assignment, to show people how long everyday items take to decompose. Take a photo with CameraX, and ML Kit image labeling identifies the item; the app then shows the photo, its best-guess label, an estimated decomposition time and notes on the factors involved (for example paper type, moisture, temperature and microbial activity for paper).

Highlights:
- CameraX capture and live preview, with ML Kit on-device image labeling (highest-confidence label wins).
- A decomposition lookup keyed by label, with a time range and notes for each item.
- Navigation-drawer UI with a gallery view.
